meta.rule: Values as served by the IMF SDMX API for each WEO vintage; vintages are kept separate. Type per year from the WEO latest-actual-year attribute: actual up to it, estimate after it and before the edition year, projection from the edition year on. Projections are never labelled actual. Missing values stay null.

type_rule.estimate: latest_actual_year < year < edition_year (or no latest_actual_year given)
